_comment: Visual identity is CONSpread (the account). Palette derived from the CONSpread logo (assets/brand/). 'Building Tomorrow' is the content source, credited in text, not as a mark. Consumers read tokens by id, never raw hex.

primary.note: CONSpread navy. Default dark for headlines, body and structure.

accent_variants.source: CONSpread logo: Logo wordmark 'CONS' / left wing
CONSpread logo: Gradient midpoint where the wings meet
CONSpread logo: Logo wordmark 'pread' / right wing

rules: One accent per post; rotate crimson / plum / navy across posts (state/design-memory.json).
Ground is paper (soft off-white) or navy. Text is navy on light, white on navy or crimson.
Accent = emphasis marks, small shapes, the number badge. Highlight bands use the accent 'tint' with navy text (contrast >= 7).
Never set body text in crimson or plum on paper (contrast below 4.5). Crimson is for large display or on navy only.

typography._comment: Script (Alex Brush) confirmed from the cover PDF; Anton and Manrope are the closest OFL matches to the outlined cover artwork and the references.

script.use: single accent phrase per post, e.g. an italic-feel kicker. Never body text.

headline.source: proposed (closest OFL match to the condensed heavy grotesque in the cover and in the carousel references)
headline.case: sentence or title case, tight leading

body.source: proposed (clean geometric sans, readable at phone size)

wordmark.use: only for the cover artwork itself; never re-typeset it. Use the cover image or a locked-up logo file instead.

rules: Fonts must be redistributable (OFL) and committed under assets/fonts/ so every machine renders identically.
Do not re-typeset the BUILDING TOMORROW title; use the cover art.

slots._comment: Every template exposes these slots. Same skeleton, different clothes each render.

rules: Full colour on light grounds; white version on navy/crimson. Never recolour the gradient, never stretch, never add effects.
Clear space on all sides >= 0.4x the logo height. One logo per slide.

imagery_motifs.guidance: Do NOT blow the logo up as decoration. If a surface needs a graphic, use a single wing silhouette as a low-opacity (<=6%) navy watermark, or a thin crimson->navy gradient rule. Keep it restrained.

brand._comment: On-image identity = the CONSpread logo image (assets/brand/). mark_text is a text fallback only. book_credit names the content source.
